summary: This database contains historical Formula 1 race data spanning multiple seasons (1950+), with core entities being races, drivers, constructors (teams), and circuits (venues). The primary fact tables are results (race finishing positions and points), qualifying (session times), and standings tables (cumulative season-to-date metrics). Notable quirks include lap times stored as text format (e.g., "1:49.088") with parallel milliseconds columns, pit stop durations similarly dual-encoded, nationality stored as adjectives (e.g., "British"), and standings tracked after each race with position and cumulative wins recorded.
